> A wireless power transfer system where a transmitter coil delivers power to a receiver only after OTP-based authorization. Two ESP32s handle the handshake and control, and a live dashboard shows voltage, current and delivery status in real time. The original version won a prize at TechnoMax 2026. This build turns it into a proper custom PCB with a cleaner coil driver stage and a real enclosure.
